configurePresets.name: native64
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86_64 -- SDL2 + both GL devices, no Pixomatic
configurePresets.description: 64-bit native build: the same engine and recovered Karma as `native`, at LP64. No Pixomatic (its prebuilts are i386-only on both platforms and there is no source), so -SOFTWARERENDERER does not exist here. 32-bit (`native`) is the default width. Builds in build-native64/ -> ut2004.bin.

configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86 -- SDL2, both GL devices + Pixomatic, one binary
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (the default width): SDL2Drv + OpenGLDrv (desktop GL) + GL4ESDrv (GL->GLES2 translation) + PixoDrv (the Pixomatic software renderer) in one binary; pick at startup with -OPENGLRENDERER / -GL4ESRENDERER / -SOFTWARERENDERER. The recovered Karma (USE_KARMA_DECOMP, the default) gives vehicles and ragdolls; `native-nokarma` is the physics-off control. Builds in build-native/ -> ut2004-pixo.bin.

configurePresets.name: legacy-karma
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86 -- the reference Karma (MathEngine's shipped archives): the A/B arm
configurePresets.description: `native` with BUILD_KARMA_REF instead of USE_KARMA_DECOMP: the same engine and renderers, with MathEngine's prebuilt i386 archives as the physics, the reference the recovered Karma is compared against (in CI too). 32-bit x86 Linux only: the archives are binary-only i386, and configure refuses anything else. Builds in build-legacy-karma/ -> ut2004-legacykarma-pixo.bin, so it can sit beside the recovered binary.

configurePresets.name: native-sse
configurePresets.displayName: Native Linux x86 -- the ktrace control arm (32-bit, SSE float math, no Pixomatic)
configurePresets.description: The 32-bit pointer-width control for metoolkit-karma-decomp's decomp/test/ut2004/ktrace_gate.sh: the recovered Karma at -m32 with -msse2 -mfpmath=sse, so the only variable against a 64-bit trace is the pointer width (`native` runs its doubles on x87 at 80-bit). No Pixomatic. Builds in build-native-sse/ -> ut2004.bin.

configurePresets.name: physics
configurePresets.description: gl4es stack with WITH_PHYSICS=ON. Builds in build-physics/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions + exception catching. The everyday dev build and the shipped -debug binary: named stacks and readable errors at a playable speed. The largest of the three (DWARF plus un-cleaned-up inlining). Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK). Requires -DUE_ASSETS_DIR=<UT2004 folder> (the link embeds System/Build.ini and System/Packages.md5 from it).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. For when the optimiser is the suspect (a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour). Several times the wasm size and a much slower boot. Builds in build-wasm-debug/. Requires -DUE_ASSETS_DIR=<UT2004 folder> (the link embeds System/Build.ini and System/Packages.md5 from it).

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O3, assertions off, no debug info (a side symbol map) -- the shipping build. Builds in build-wasm-perf/. Run `source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh` first. Requires -DUE_ASSETS_DIR=<UT2004 folder> (the link embeds System/Build.ini and System/Packages.md5 from it).

configurePresets.name: windows64
configurePresets.displayName: 64-bit Windows (MinGW-w64 cross) -- with the recovered Karma
configurePresets.description: The x86_64 Windows build. MinGW cannot use MathEngine's archives, so the Windows physics is the recovered Karma (portable C). LLP64 (`long` is 4 bytes, pointers 8), the only target with that combination; validated by the same ktrace as every other target (metoolkit-karma-decomp's decomp/test/ut2004/ktrace_run.sh runs the .exe under wine). USE_PIXOMATIC=OFF overrides the ON inherited from `windows` (Pixomatic is 32-bit only). Builds in build-windows64/ -> ut2004.exe.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.displayName: Windows x86 (MinGW-w64) -- SDL2, both GL devices + Pixomatic
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build (MinGW-w64 cross from Linux): SDL2 + OpenGLDrv (desktop GL) + GL4ESDrv + PixoDrv, picked at startup with -OPENGLRENDERER / -GL4ESRENDERER / -SOFTWARERENDERER, with the recovered Karma. pixomatic.lib is an import library, so pixomatic.dll is a load-time dependency: it is vendored at Thirdparty/Pixomatic/Bin/pixomatic.dll and staged beside the exe, as OpenAL32.dll is. Builds in build-windows/ -> ut2004-pixo.exe.
